summary: fractal-ui ships a Transcript composition and a plain-language sync line, with consent-gated Markdown images and a host-owned retry for a failed send. Both scroll lanes offer Scroll to end only when detached more than 40 px; focus and input signals without movement preserve following, no-op explicit navigation preserves its mode, native focus navigation is measured against the observed scroll coordinate, virtual resize pins before paint and detached virtual history compensates growth or shrink above the reader, momentum reaching the end resumes following, and attached virtual lanes repin non-reader displacement even when a same-height acknowledgement does not trigger resize. Scroll to end hides on press intent and eases toward the growing live edge, yielding immediately to reader input; reduced motion skips or cancels that animation and settles the current end immediately.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Only packages/fractal-ui changes; no protocol, harness or CLI change. The package exports Transcript, TranscriptFeedback and EmbraceScrollViewport, and the conversation model gains an optional sendState that the host may leave unreported. Two additive host options: TranscriptAvailability's Unavailable variant gains an optional action ({ label, onPress }) for the host's recovery button, and ThreadHeader gains an optional terminalDisabledReason that shows the terminal toggle disabled with that reason; hosts that omit either see no new control. The unavailable state no longer shows a sync line and keeps its detail behind Show details. The assistant-ui/shell entry also exports TerminalDrawer. Sync line wording changes; its inputs do not.
